question: The purpose of the stranger’s visit is:
solution:
The correct answer is "**to consult him**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The theme of the passage is an episode from the famous **Sherlock Holmes** novel where a stranger(Dr. Mortimer) approaches Sherlock with a peculiar case.
 
• In the **fourth paragraph **of the passage, it is stated that the stranger wanted to hire Mr. Holmes to **solve a serious problem he was facing**.
 
• It is mentioned in the** last line** of the fourth paragraph. He was meeting with Mr. Holmes as the latter was the second-best expert in this field in Europe.

Hence, the correct answer is **option 1**.
